purpose: Identify the subject, or connect a contrasting clause.
keywords: Noun + が; polite clause + が + contrasting clause.
There is a cat outside the window.
It is expensive, but it sells well.
Set a topic or identify a subject
formation: Noun + が; polite clause + が + contrasting clause.
restrictions: Subject が and connective が are different functions.
mistake: Do not assume every が means the same thing.
